image.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: reusable generic illustration for a Chinese graduation-project medicine catalog, NOT a photograph of any real product. Create one square polished flat/isometric editorial illustration, soft off-white background, neutral unbranded teal and pale blue plain carton, abstract rounded forms beside it, no identifiable medication formulation or dose, no realistic commercial branding. Leave generous margins. The only text must be a large crisp readable two-line label centered in a dedicated pale warm yellow band at the bottom: "演示插图" and "非实际商品包装". This disclaimer must be inside the image, readable even at thumbnail size. No drug names, company names, Rx or OTC symbols, approval numbers, barcodes, QR codes, dosage, efficacy statements or medical claims. Do not imitate any existing packaging or trademark. Friendly clean illustrated style, clearly fictional, no photorealism. One standalone image, not a grid.
